units.x: m east of the city origin
units.n: m north of the city origin
units.h: m above sea level of the main-gear contact point (on the ground: the surface)
units.s: m flown along the ground track since the first sample
units.gear: 0 up and locked, 1 down and locked
units.lights: bit field (section 5.5): NAV 1, BEACON 2, STROBE 4, LANDING 8, TAXI 16, TURNOFF 32, LOGO 64, WING 128; every lamp that is on has its bit

provenanceNotes.h: ADS-B geometric altitude, calibrated on the runway; wheels = antenna - 5.6 m (estimate); the flare (last seconds before the recorded air-to-ground transition) is modelled
provenanceNotes.tas: ground velocity minus the wind of `atmosphere` (Open-Meteo GFS pressure levels for the hour (section 6.4))
provenanceNotes.ias: calibrated airspeed for the true airspeed in the profile's temperature and the standard pressure
provenanceNotes.hdg: direction of the air velocity: the crab into the wind, taken off over the last 5 s before touchdown; the track on the ground
provenanceNotes.roll: coordinated turn, atan(V w / g), from the turn rate of the air velocity; limited to 30 deg and 5 deg/s
provenanceNotes.pitch: flight-path angle through the air plus angle of attack from lift, CL = n W / (q S) with alpha = alpha0(flap) + CL / CLalpha fitted to the reference attitudes of section 7.3; weight 69.7 t from the approach speed; the flare raises the nose at most 3 deg; the nose comes down over 5 s after touchdown
provenanceNotes.turbulence: 30 s RMS of the recorded minus the smoothed vertical rate, 2 m/s = 1
provenanceNotes.flap: selected 1, 5, 15, 30 by speed (within 10 kt of the current setting's manoeuvring speed for 70 t) or gate (1 by 22 km, 5 before joining final, 15 with the gear, landing flap by 300 m), never while the rest of the approach exceeds the new setting's placard; travel 1 lever unit/s (estimate); selected: 1 at 1487s (speed), 5 at 1563s (speed), 15 at 1647s (speed), 30 at 1661s (placard)
provenanceNotes.slat: extend with flaps 1 to 5, full extend beyond 5 (spec.py SLATS schedule)
provenanceNotes.gear: down with flaps 15, never above 270 kt, before the landing flap; 10 s travel (estimate)
provenanceNotes.speedbrake: low confidence: only where the descent, in energy terms, is more than 25% steeper than clean idle explains, clean and above 600 m; 0 on the ground (the ground spoilers carry it there)
provenanceNotes.groundSpoiler: 0.5 s after touchdown until taxi speed
provenanceNotes.reverser: sleeves from 2 s after touchdown until taxi speed (idle reverse from 60 kt)
provenanceNotes.lights: section 7.8: position and beacon throughout, strobes until vacating, landing below 10,000 ft until vacating, turn-off from gear down, taxi after vacating, wing and logo at night below 10,000 ft
provenanceNotes.cabinLight: dimmed to 0.3 from 10,000 ft when the sun is more than 6 deg below the horizon

reconstructed.what: flare: wheel height modelled from 6.0 m to the runway

atmosphereNote: altitude m above sea level, temperature degC, wind toward grid east and grid north m/s (true north turned into the city grid at the airport); Open-Meteo GFS pressure levels for the hour (section 6.4), with the airport's surface report blended in below 600 m above it

waiver.reason: Smoothed minus raw height RMS over the last 60 s is 3.62 m against 3 m. The plan notes this gate sits at the noise floor of altitudes reported in 25 ft steps (7.6 m steps alone give 2.2 m RMS); the remaining bias over that minute is under 0.4 m (0.08 m on this flight), so the residual is the GNSS heights' own scatter, not an error of the track; and this is the only flight found in three dusk evenings that meets every selection criterion. Waived for this flight and this gate only, decided 2026-11-25.
